app.title: Chamkar
app.subtitle: A Khmer village farm
app.tagline: Raise animals, make treats and send them to market, across 150 levels.

home.allDone: Every level done! Go back for three stars.
home.how1: Tap the pen to water the grass. Animals eat it, then lay eggs or give milk.
home.how2: Tap goods to put them in the barn. Workshops turn them into treats.
home.how3: Send the tuk-tuk to market for coins, and fill each order fast for three stars.

village.name: The Village
village.blurb: Grandpa Ta's yard, a few hens and plenty of sunshine.

ricefield.name: Rice Fields
ricefield.blurb: Ducks paddle by the paddies. Watch out for monkeys!

riverside.name: Riverside
riverside.blurb: Cows graze by the river, and the dairy opens.

temple.name: Temple Hills
temple.blurb: Pilgrims love sweet desserts, and so do the temple monkeys.

palmgrove.name: Palm Grove
palmgrove.blurb: Dry season: grass grows slowly and the well is slow to fill.

festival.name: Water Festival
festival.blurb: The whole country comes to town. Big orders, fast!

chicken.name: Chickens
chicken.text: Feed them grass and they lay eggs. Tap the eggs before they spoil.

duck.name: Ducks
duck.text: Ducks lay duck eggs, worth almost twice a hen's.

cow.name: Cows
cow.text: Cows give milk. They're slow, but milk sells well.

bakery.name: Bakery
bakery.text: Tap the empty plot to build it, then tap it to bake eggs into cakes.

saltjar.name: Salt jars
saltjar.text: Duck eggs soak in salty water and come out as salted eggs.

stall.name: Dessert stall
stall.text: Each dessert needs a cake and a yogurt. The finest thing on the farm.

monkey.name: Monkeys
monkey.text: They sneak in to steal goods and eat the grass. Tap them until they run off.

truck.name: The tuk-tuk
truck.text: Tap the tuk-tuk or the barn, load goods, and send them to market for coins.

dry.name: Dry season
dry.text: Watering grows less grass, and the well takes longer to fill.

festival.name: Water Festival
festival.text: Bigger orders and a faster tuk-tuk. More monkeys, too.

briefing.monkeys: Monkeys about: {n} taps chase one off

game.barnFull: The barn is full: sell something!
game.noWebgl: This device can't show the 3D farm (WebGL is off or not supported).

hints.collect: Tap the eggs to put them in the barn.
hints.water: Hungry hens? Tap the pen to water the grass.
hints.well: Out of water? Tap the well to fill it.
hints.buy: Buy chickens at the bottom of the screen.
hints.build: Tap the empty plot to build the bakery.
hints.bake: Collect eggs, then tap the bakery to bake a cake.
hints.truck: Tap the tuk-tuk, load goods and send them to market.

market.title: Tuk-tuk to market
market.barnEmpty: The barn is empty. Collect goods in the pen.
market.truckEmpty: Tap goods above to load them.
market.awayText: The tuk-tuk is at the market. The coins come when it's back.

intro.0: Srey! You're home from the city. The farm has missed you, and so have I.
intro.1: Ta, I want to help. Let's make this the best farm in the village!
intro.2: Then start with the hens. Water the grass, and they'll lay for you.
intro.3: And whatever we don't need, the tuk-tuk takes to market!

intro.0: The rice is green as far as I can see. Ducks would love it here.
intro.1: Duck eggs make salted eggs, everyone's favourite with rice porridge.
intro.2: Hee hee! Eggs lying about? Nobody will miss one or two...
intro.3: That's Sva, the cheekiest monkey around. Tap him till he runs!

intro.0: By the river the grass grows thick. Time for cows.
intro.1: Milk, and then yogurt from the dairy. The market will love it.
intro.2: Cows are slow, but patient farmers do well.

intro.0: Pilgrims climb the hill every day. They'll want something sweet.
intro.1: A dessert stall! Cake and yogurt in one glass, like my mother made.
intro.2: The temple is MY hill. And now it has desserts. Hee hee!

intro.0: The dry season is here. Every bucket counts.
intro.1: Then I'll water where the animals are, not everywhere.
intro.2: Clever girl. The palms give shade, and the well never quite runs dry.

intro.0: The Water Festival! Boats on the river and crowds everywhere.
intro.1: Big orders, Srey. Keep the tuk-tuk busy.
intro.2: So many treats, so little time. My whole family is coming!

outro.0: Every order filled. Srey, this is the finest farm in the land.
outro.1: Fine, fine. Maybe... next time I could just ask?
outro.2: Ask nicely, Sva, and there's always a banana for you. Happy Water Festival!
